comparison.objective: Recap a practice syringe using a one-handed scoop while keeping the other hand clear; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Syringe recapping tests one-handed cap capture and axial alignment. Candidate requires bimanual stabilization, hex-key use, collar rotation, relocking, and iterative force-response judgment.
comparison.success_condition: The cap must be placed on the needle and released without using the other hand; candidate requires two constrained physical impact cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve precision alignment, but they test materially different abilities: one-handed sharps-safe insertion versus iterative mechanical tuning and retention.
